testing_and_data_ids.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive multi-page React application with client-side routing (React Router) matching all 8 routes.
Implement shared Header and Footer across all pages with a z-50 sticky header.
Ensure 'Request Beta Access' CTA opens a full interactive dialog with data-testid attributes.
Ensure all contact forms (modal and bottom sections) call the backend POST /api/contact endpoint and trigger Sonner toasts.
Apply high-contrast emerald green accents on deep navy/charcoal dark theme.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and cards have explicit hover/focus state contrast.
